name: Deck of Cards API
tagline: Free HTTP API to shuffle, draw, and pile standard playing cards
description: A simple, free public API for creating, shuffling, drawing, and organizing standard 52-card decks (with optional jokers). Supports multi-deck shoes, named piles, and remaining-card tracking—ideal for browser or server game prototypes without auth or billing.

auth.details: No authentication required. Endpoints are publicly accessible over HTTPS with no API key or signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Entirely free; no published request quota or paid plans

use_cases: shuffle a new multi-deck shoe for a card game prototype
draw N cards from a deck and track remaining count
move drawn cards into named piles for hands or discard
reshuffle remaining cards mid-game without losing pile state
add jokers to a deck for games that need them
return cards from a pile back into the deck
